Based on the retrieved knowledge, here is a summary of your resume [Source 1]: 
You are a B.Tech CSE student with strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming, experienced in building scalable full-stack applications and backend systems. 

Your work experience includes being a Summer Research Intern at SRM University-AP [Source 2], where you built an end-to-end ML system using Gradient Boosting to predict credit scores and deployed an interactive Streamlit dashboard. You are also a Core Team Member at Google Developer Groups (GDG) [Source 2], where you tracked registration data, increased participant engagement, and led campaigns.

Your technical skills include proficiency in programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, C, C++, and Java [Source 3], as well as experience with web technologies, backend & APIs, databases, machine learning, and data science & analytics. 

You also have certifications in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2025 Certified Data Science Professional, Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer, and MongoDB Certified Associate Developer (Node.js) [Source 4]. 

Note that the retrieved knowledge does not contain any information about your education or personal statement, so this summary is based solely on the provided sources.

Based on the information available, it appears that one of your notable projects was building an end-to-end Machine Learning (ML) system. In this project, you utilized Gradient Boosting to predict credit scores. 

The key aspects of this project include:

1. **Machine Learning Model:** You employed Gradient Boosting, a popular and powerful ML algorithm, to develop a predictive model for credit scores. Gradient Boosting is known for its ability to handle complex datasets and provide accurate predictions.

2. **End-to-End System:** The project involved designing and implementing a complete system, from data collection and preprocessing to model training and deployment. This comprehensive approach demonstrates your capability to manage all stages of a project.

3. **Streamlit Dashboard:** A significant component of your project was the development of an interactive Streamlit dashboard. Streamlit is a Python library that allows for the creation of web apps for data science and machine learning in a straightforward manner. The inclusion of a dashboard suggests that you aimed to make the predictions and possibly the underlying data accessible and understandable to a broader audience, facilitating interaction and exploration of the results.

4. **Deployment:** By deploying the model and the dashboard, you ensured that your project was not only theoretically sound but also practically usable. This step is crucial as it makes the project results available to those who can benefit from them, such as financial institutions looking to assess creditworthiness.

This project showcases your skills in machine learning, data science, and full-stack development, highlighting your ability to conceive, execute, and deploy complex data-driven projects.
